verdict.rationale: The tutorial documents per-member tool access control: an admin can choose which tools each member may use and whether they may run CLIs locally, at invite time or later. This is a real allowlist-style restriction, but it is scoped to team members rather than explicitly to agents, rests on a single thin mention, and does not show finer control over individual operations or endpoints. missing for 10: explicit per-agent or per-token scoping, per-operation/endpoint-level allowlists, detailed configuration docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
